days_to_first_harvest.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for kharif crops
days_to_first_harvest.quote: It matures in about 132 days and vacates the field well in time to sow the succeeding wheat crop
days_to_first_harvest.note: Early PAU varieties AL 882 and PAU 881.

spacing_row_cm.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for kharif crops
spacing_row_cm.quote: Sow the crop at a row spacing of 50 cm and the plant spacing of 25 cm

water_need.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for kharif crops
water_need.quote: Apply the first irrigation 3 to 4 weeks after sowing
water_need.note: Few irrigations or a rainfed crop is read as 'low'; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for kharif crops
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: grain yield is about 5.1 quintals per acre
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.note: A q/acre figure is converted at 4047 m² per acre: 5.1 q/acre = 0.13 kg/m².

spacing_plant_cm.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for kharif crops
spacing_plant_cm.quote: Sow the crop at a row spacing of 50 cm and the plant spacing of 25 cm

source_notes: AI research batch 11 (2026-10-07). Ranges are stored at their lower bound unless a note says otherwise; the source range is in each quote. Sowing months for Madhya Pradesh come from the state crop-season table (SLBC); other values are TNAU/PAU guides (Tamil Nadu, Punjab) until a local source is found.
